body_text:
For an ordered basis $B=(b_1,\ldots,b_n)$ of $V$, the
coordinate map $[\,\cdot\,]_B:V\to F^n$ sends
$v=\sum_i a_i b_i$ to the column $(a_1,\ldots,a_n)^T$. It is a
linear isomorphism. Coordinates depend on $B$; the vector being
represented does not.
